_metadata._description: Attacker with 2 bridges: destructible 50 HP in ARMOR + indestructible 1B HP in CORE

name: Test Attacker Beam CNC DualBridge
_test_notes: Two bridges on different layers: 50 HP in ARMOR (destroyed first by incoming fire) + 1B HP in CORE (effectively indestructible). After ARMOR bridge dies, CORE bridge still provides C&C so beam keeps firing. For CNC-006 redundancy test.
